IT SETUP GUIDE (v1)
===================

MFA REQUIREMENT
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is REQUIRED for email and VPN access.

NEW EMPLOYEE ACCOUNT SETUP
1) Open your email client and sign in with your temporary password.
2) Change your password when prompted.
3) Enroll in MFA using the authenticator app recommended by IT.
4) Join the company Slack workspace using your company email address.

VPN SETUP (REMOTE WORK)
1) Install the VPN client from the Company Software Portal.
2) Sign in with your company credentials.
3) Complete MFA when prompted.
4) Confirm you can reach internal systems.

HELPDESK
- Email: it-helpdesk@company.example

- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–6:00 PM
